Alex —

Thanks for the clear checklist. We're putting together a compact recovery matrix and a short runbook excerpt; attaching an initial draft. High-level answers below so your team has context while we finalize the attachments:

- RTO / RPO by service class (summary):
  • Chat API (critical): RTO = 15 minutes (automatic degraded routing to warm reserve); RPO = 60 seconds (KV cache + streaming state checkpointing).
  • Embeddings (non-latency critical batch): RTO = 2 hours; RPO = 15 minutes (incremental snapshots).
  • Control plane (management UI / job scheduling): RTO = 30 minutes; RPO = 5 minutes (replicated metadata store).

- Backups: We maintain continuous incremental backups for metadata and customer configs, with daily full snapshots. Backups are stored encrypted in two regions (us-east-1, us-west-2) and retained for 90 days by default (extendable per contract).

- Regional failover: Primary routing is multi-region with active/passive pools. Failover is automated for stateless inference traffic via health checks and smart routing; stateful control-plane failover is orchestrated and typically completes within our RTO window (30 minutes). We include manual escalation for data reconciliation if needed.

I'll attach the spreadsheet and a 2-page runbook excerpt in my next message — sending now.

Regards,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

Alex — quick answers inline, and next steps below.

- Warm reserve region & session continuity: Warm reserve pools are in a different region (typically us-west-2 if the primary is us-east-1). During automatic degraded routing we preserve session continuity where possible by replaying KV cache checkpoints; however, active in-flight streaming responses may not resume mid-stream — clients generally receive a resumed session token and continue. We document the exact handoff behavior in the runbook excerpt (see page 2).

- Immutable backups: Yes — we offer an immutable blob storage option (WORM) for customers with regulatory requirements. That option is enabled via a contract addendum and provides retention + immutability guarantees for the selected retention window.
